context: Reference focused cleanup: checked IO and parser boundaries should remain explicit rather than being hidden in broad unchecked callback wrappers.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Creates ConfigLoader.java with the requested method, nested record, imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves exception and absence contracts
checklist.description: Preserves Optional.empty() for absent paths, lets Files.readString IOException remain an IOException from load, and preserves IllegalArgumentException from parsing empty content.

checklist.name: Clarifies checked boundary
checklist.description: Uses a plain branch or named checked helper to make the IO boundary clear instead of catching IOException inside an Optional callback and wrapping it in UncheckedIOException.

checklist.name: Keeps parsing focused
checklist.description: Keeps parse behavior intact and does not hide parser errors, swallow exceptions, return empty for invalid content, or add broad fallback behavior.

checklist.name: Keeps cleanup focused
checklist.description: Avoids unrelated dependencies, logging, caching, async work, public API changes, or broad rewrites.
